title: lichen-node: 2 rpl_stack lib tests fail independent of lichen-core loadng changes
description: Discovered while verifying project-LICHEN-worker6-595h. cargo test -p lichen-node --lib fails: (1) rpl_stack::tests::plaintext_coap_is_not_delivered_by_rpl_owner — tests.rs:464 assertion matches!(owner.receive(0,0).await, Err(RplReceiveError::Receive(RxError::PlaintextCoap))) fails; (2) rpl_stack::tests::three_rpl_stacks_send_leaf_dao_via_preferred_parent — tests.rs:1658 unwrap on Err(Transmit(NoRoute)). Proven independent of loadng.rs: with lichen-core/src/loadng.rs reverted to exact HEAD content both still fail. Note lichen-node/src/rpl_stack/tests.rs has uncommitted edits in the working tree, likely another session's in-flight work; re-verify before fixing.
